info.title: TitanSystem closed cash journal CSV export
info.description: Read-only local cash-operational export, original operator/store/device and Sell permission. History does not require active POS license. Source validation, summary and ALL entries share one SQLite snapshot; the response is buffered before attachment headers are set. No bank/provider confirmation, statutory accounting, fiscal document or frontend button. Text fields are unchanged: nonempty cells must start with a Unicode letter/digit or underscore, contain no controls, be valid UTF-8 and at most4096 bytes; otherwise422, not apostrophe escaping or silently changing IDs. Canonical JSON history remains available. Spreadsheet opening/save/reopen has not been tested on real Excel/LibreOffice. IDs/dates should be imported as text; CSV does not declare spreadsheet cell types.

200.description: Complete UTF-8 CSV, semicolon delimiter, BOM, CRLF; fixed attachment filename. One summary row then one row per entry. All monetary columns are exact INTEGER CENTS, not currency decimals. Empty optional actor/operation means unknown. Summary-only columns are empty in entry rows. format_version=1, scope=cash_operational. No pagination or partial file.

400.description: Invalid ID, any query parameter or GET body

404.description: Not found or outside original operator/store/device scope

409.description: Open session or inconsistent cash/source/closure history

413.description: More than 10000 journal entries or more than 16 MiB encoded CSV; no truncation

422.description: Exact integer range exceeded, or text cannot round-trip safely in CSV
